text: Hey, saw ur profile. That hiking pic is insane, where was that?
Hey! Thanks, that was up near the national park last fall. The view was worth the climb lol. You have a really good eye btw, your photos are great.
Thx! Means a lot. Tbh it's kinda hard to find someone normal on here. You seem like you actually get out and do things.
Haha, I try. This app is a grind for sure. So what's your story? What do you do when you're not taking cool photos?

It's kinda complicated rn, working on a personal art project. Honestly this app is so buggy and the notifications are annoying. Would you be open to chatting on Telegram or something? No pressure, I just find it easier.
Yeah for sure, I get it. My username on there is the same as here. What's the art project about? Sounds cool.

Awesome, will add u in a bit. Just got caught up in some stuff. And I'd rather tell you about the project when we can talk properly, it's kinda personal. But really looking forward to talking more. It's been a while since I've clicked with someone.
No worries, I get it. Me too. It's been a nice surprise. Talk soon.
Hey, just sent you a request on Tele. Srry for the late message, my brain is fried tonight. Dealing with some family drama. U are a nice distraction from it all.
Got it, added you back! And hey, no problem. Sorry you're dealing with stress. If you need to vent, I'm here. Anything I can do?
Morning, Mark :) hope you slept well. I woke up thinking about our chat and it made me smile.
Morning, Sophia. Slept great, thanks. And yeah, me too. It’s a nice change to wake up to.
For sure. So I have a random question for you... what's something you've always wanted to do but never did bc life got in the way?
Haha wow, starting deep today! I like it. Honestly? I've always wanted to take a year off and just build stuff. Like proper furniture, with my hands. But you know... mortgage, job, etc.
I can totally see that for you. It's a shame that practical stuff gets in the way of actually living, you know?
That's exactly it. What about you? What's your secret dream?
Sorry, got distracted. I think for me, it'd be opening a tiny art gallery by the ocean. Nothing fancy, just real stuff. But I think I'm too scared to do something like that alone.
Yeah, a partner in crime makes any big jump less scary.
Can't sleep. Just thinking about our convo today. I haven't felt this optimistic in a long time. So, thanks for that.
You don't have to thank me. I feel it too. Get some rest. Talk tomorrow.
Night Mark ❤️
Hey. srry i've been mia. a lot is going on here.
Hey, no problem. I was just thinking about you. Everything okay?
not really. im at the hospital. its my mom. i dont want to get into it and bother u.
What? Sophia, you're not bothering me at all. Oh my god. I'm so sorry. Is she going to be okay?
she fell, its complicated. im so stressed i cant think straight. honestly ur the only person ive told. i feel so alone in this.
You're not alone. I'm here. Seriously. Whatever you need. Please keep me updated when you can.
just talked to a doctor. its not good. she needs surgery. i just can't deal with this.
That's awful, I'm so sorry. Just take a deep breath. She's strong, and she has you. That's what matters.
i wish it was that simple. now theyre talking about insurance problems. because of my visa status, things are really difficult. its a complete nightmare, Mark. 😔
What kind of problems? Is there anything I can do? Maybe I can help research something or make a call?
I'm sorry I haven't been myself. Trying to keep it together but it feels like my whole world is falling apart.
Don't ever apologize for that. You're going through hell. I'm just worried about you. Any news on your mom?
She's stable but the surgery is tomorrow. The problem is the hospital... they want a massive deposit upfront because we're not permanent residents. They said they wont do the surgery without it.
A deposit? Are you serious? They can't just deny her care. How much are they asking for?
Its... a lot. I've used everything I have. I tried to get a small loan but they said no bc of my visa. I feel so helpless. like i'm failing her.
You are NOT failing her. You're doing everything you possibly can. Don't think that for a second. What's the shortfall? What's the number you need to hit?
i feel sick even saying the number. I tried selling my camera gear online but it's taking too long. My mom's life is on the line and i'm here trying to sell a lens... it's just so humiliating 😭
Stop. Don't sell your gear. Sophia... I want to help. I can't just stand by while this is happening. Tell me what you need.
Mark, no. I could never ask u for that. You've already done so much just by being here for me. This is my problem.
It's not just your problem. We're in this together, right? I have some savings. I can send it. Just tell me how. We'll figure out the rest later. Your mom is the only thing that matters right now.
Hey there. Is that a vintage guitar in your first picture? You look like a total rockstar.
Haha, I don't know about rockstar, but good eye! It's a replica of an old classic. I enjoy playing. Your profile is really artistic, you have a great sense of style.
Thank you! I'm a design student, so that means a lot. It's so rare to find someone with a real passion on here. Most profiles are just... boring.
I know what you mean. So you're a designer? That's really cool. What kind of stuff do you design?

Womenswear mostly. It's my final year so it's super intense. Tbh I'm never on this app, the notifications drive me crazy. Are you on WhatsApp? I find it's just easier to chat there if you're open to it.
Sure, I get that. I'll message you my number. And good luck with your final year, sounds like a lot of pressure.
Hey you. I was just sketching and listening to that band you recommended. It’s been so nice talking to you the last few days.
Hey Isabella. I'm glad you like them! And I feel the same way. It's been the best part of my week, easily.
Mine too :) It makes me wonder... if you could do anything, no limits, what would be your dream job or project?
Wow, big question. I guess I've always dreamed of opening a small, intimate music venue. A place with great sound, craft beer, where local bands could play. But that's just a pipe dream lol.
That's not a pipe dream, that's an amazing idea! I can totally picture it. It's funny, my dream is to open a small boutique for independent designers. A place with real, unique art to wear.
See? We're a perfect match. A music venue with a cool fashion boutique inside. We could call it 'The Sound and the Style' haha.
Stop, I love that! ❤️ It feels like you just... get me. You know? It’s a nice feeling.
I can't stop thinking about our venue. I feel more hopeful about the future than I have in a long time. Thank you for that.
Me too. Seriously. Now get some sleep, you have designing to do. Talk tomorrow.
david something awful has happened
Isabella? What is it? Are you okay?
no. im not. my bag was stolen. from a cafe. my laptop. my work. everything. my entire final project is gone. years of work. gone.
Oh my god. I'm so sorry. Are you sure it's gone? Did you talk to the police?
yes they cant do anything. the deadline is in two weeks. if i dont submit i fail the course. if i fail i lose my student visa. my whole life was on that laptop. im so scared.
Okay, just breathe. This is horrible, but we can figure it out. The university has to understand. They have to give you an extension.

they dont care. they said i need a police report and even then an extension is not guaranteed. im just one international student to them. talking to you is the only thing thats not making me have a full panic attack.

I haven't slept. I've been trying to figure out what to do. The main problem is the design software on my laptop, it's incredibly specialized and expensive. I can't even begin to remake my portfolio without it.
I've been thinking about you constantly. What's the cost for the software? Is there a student discount?
Even with a discount it's thousands. Money I don't have. I spent my savings on materials that were also stolen. I feel so defeated. I think I might have to just give up and go home.
No. Don't say that. You've worked too hard. We are not letting this happen. How much is it exactly?
It's too much, David. I've been looking at taking a terrible cash-in-hand job at a pub, working 16 hour days, but I'd never have time to actually redo my designs. It's hopeless. I'm failing.
You're not working at some awful pub. You're a designer. I want to help you. I can cover the software. Let me do this.
What? no. i couldn't possibly ask you to do that. this is my mess. you've already helped just by being here for me.
I'm not asking, I'm telling you. You're not in this alone. We're a team, remember? The Sound and the Style isn't going to build itself. Just tell me the best way to get the money to you.
Hey Chloe. I stumbled on your profile and had to message you. The dish in your third picture looks absolutely incredible. I miss real home cooking out here.
Oh wow, thank you! That's my homemade lasagna. 'Out here'... where is that? Your photos are stunning, by the way. Are you a photographer?
I am! Good eye. I'm a wildlife photographer, currently on a conservation project in Thailand. And yes, I'd trade a good picture of a leopard for a plate of that lasagna right now haha.
Thailand! How amazing. That sounds like a dream job. I'm a nurse, so my life is a little less exotic.

Being a nurse is incredible, you help people every day. That's way more important than what I do. Hey, the satellite internet here is terrible and this app drains my battery. Would you mind if we switched to Telegram? It's just more reliable for me.
Of course, I totally understand. My username is the same as on here. It would be great to chat more.
Good morning from my side of the world. :) Just looking at the sunrise and thinking about our chat last night. You have such a kind soul, Chloe.
Morning, Leo! That sounds beautiful. And thank you, that's sweet of you to say. Talking to you has been so interesting.
It makes me curious... when you're not being a superhero nurse, what do you dream of doing?
Haha hardly a superhero. Um, it's silly, but I've always wanted to open a small cafe-bookstore. A cozy place where people can feel at home.

That's not silly, that's perfect. It's exactly the kind of place someone with your warm heart would create. My dream is to eventually build a small eco-lodge and animal sanctuary when this project is done.
Wow. That's a beautiful dream, Leo.
Just imagine your cozy cafe right in the middle of my eco-lodge. People could come for the wildlife and stay for the amazing food and books. A perfect escape.
That... actually sounds like heaven. A girl can dream, right? 😊
We should never stop dreaming. It's what keeps us going. Talking to you makes me feel like it's actually possible.
chloe. im so furious and stressed out i dont know what to do.
Leo, what's wrong? What happened?

my thermal drone crashed. the most critical piece of equipment i have for tracking the animals at night. the grant funding for this quarter is tied up in some stupid bank bureaucracy and i cant access it. im completely stuck.
Oh no, I'm so sorry! Can it be repaired? Is there a local shop?

no, the lens is shattered. its useless. and no one here can fix it. i have to order a new one from singapore but my funds are frozen. i have a very small window to track a family of leopards before they move on and the poachers in this area are ruthless. i feel like i'm letting the animals down.
That's an awful situation. It's not your fault. You're doing your best in a tough spot. Is there anything the conservation organization can do to speed up the funds?
im trying everything. its all 'protocols' and 'waiting periods'. they dont understand the urgency. sorry for dumping this on you. you're just easy to talk to.
I found a supplier in Singapore who has the drone part I need and can ship it fast. But my bank is still giving me the runaround. Time is running out for these leopards. I feel so powerless.
This is so stressful, I can't imagine. How much does the part cost with shipping?
More than I can afford out of my own pocket right now. I've put everything I have into this project. I'm not asking for me, I just keep thinking about those animals.
Leo, I want to help. This is too important to fail because of a bank error. Tell me the amount.
Chloe, no. I couldn't. This is my responsibility, not yours. You're too kind. Please don't worry about it.
I am worried about it. And I'm not taking no for an answer. We're a team, remember? Our eco-lodge needs its leopards. I can lend you the money. Just tell me how to do it.
Hello Ben. Your profile came up and I was intrigued. An architect! I'm an art historian, so I'm naturally fascinated by lines, structure, and space.
Hello Anya. It's not often I meet an art historian on here. That's a fascinating field. I'm impressed. Your photos look like they're from Italy.
Sharp eye! I'm on a fellowship in Florence for the year. It's a dream, but also isolating at times. It's refreshing to see a profile with some substance.
Florence is one of my favorite cities for architecture. I can imagine it being lonely though. I feel the same way about substance on these apps.
I have a feeling we could have a really interesting conversation. But I find this app's messaging to be so clunky. Are you on Signal? I prefer it for the privacy, if you're comfortable with that.
I am, yes. Good choice. I'll send you my number. I look forward to hearing more about your work in Florence.
Ben, I'm still thinking about our conversation about sustainable design. It's so inspiring that you want to create homes that are in harmony with nature, not just imposed upon it.
It's my passion project, for sure. One day I'll get away from the corporate grind and actually do it. Talking to you about it has made it feel more real, somehow.
That's how I feel about my own dream. I want to curate a traveling exhibition of forgotten female artists from the Renaissance. To give them a voice they never had.
That is an incredibly important and beautiful goal, Anya.
Imagine designing the exhibition space for it. A temporary structure that moves with the art, as thoughtful and beautiful as the pieces themselves. A project we could create together.
Don't say things like that, you'll make me want to quit my job tomorrow. But wow... what a thought.
It's a powerful thought, isn't it? It feels like our purposes are aligned. It's a rare feeling.
BEN. You are not going to believe this. My hands are shaking. I've found something. Something that shouldn't exist.
Anya? What is it? You sound... what's happened?

A painting. An undocumented work. I think it's by Fede Galizia, but it's not like any of her known pieces. It's in a small private collection. The family had no idea what it was. This is a once-in-a-lifetime discovery.
That's incredible! Anya, congratulations! That's huge for your work.

It is. But there's a problem. A huge one. The family is willing to sell it to me, now, for a very fair price before the big museums hear about it. But my fellowship grant forbids acquisitions. And I just used my personal savings to help my brother with his tuition. They've given me one week.
Oh, no. That's terrible timing. Is there no way the fellowship can make an exception for something this important?

I've tried. It's all red tape and rules. They just don't get it. This piece could rewrite a chapter of art history, and it's going to get locked away in a private vault in Zurich because of a stupid rule. I feel like my entire life's work is slipping through my fingers.
I've spent the last two days trying to find a solution. No bank will give me a short-term loan. I even considered selling my father's watch, but it wouldn't be enough. This is so devastating.
Anya, don't do that. This is too important to let it fail over money. What is the deposit they're asking for to secure the painting?
It's a significant amount. But please, Ben, don't even think about it. This is my professional problem, I can't drag you into my mess. It wouldn't be right.
It's not a mess, it's a historic opportunity. And we're a team, remember? Our exhibition needs its masterpiece. I want to be your patron. I can help. Tell me what you need.
Are you sure? I... I don't know what to say. I would pay you back as soon as my next grant payment comes through.
We can worry about that later. Right now, let's go save a piece of history. Just tell me the best way to get the funds to you in Florence.
Hi Sam. I know this is random, but I saw the picture of you in a suit and had to laugh. You look so serious and important, a world away from my current 'office'.
Haha, thanks I guess. It's the corporate uniform. What's your office like, then? Your photos look like you're in the middle of nowhere.
Pretty much! I'm an NGO volunteer running a clean water project in a remote part of Peru. My office is mostly mud, mosquitos, and wonderful people. A bit different from Wall Street, I imagine.
Wow. That's incredible. I'm a financial analyst, so yeah, definitely different. What you're doing is amazing.
It's rewarding but challenging. The internet here is a joke, this app barely works. Would you be open to chatting on WhatsApp? It seems to be the only thing that's reliable out here.
Absolutely. Happy to. I'll message you my number right now. I'd love to hear more about your work.
Just got back to the village after a long day. Thinking about our chat last night. Do you ever get tired of the concrete jungle and the corporate race?
You have no idea. Some days I feel like a hamster on a wheel. I make good money but I'm not sure it's making a difference, you know?

I can understand that completely. My dream is to turn this small project into a self-sustaining foundation for the whole region - water, schools, healthcare. But I'm just a field worker, I don't have the financial mind for that.
That's a huge and admirable goal, Clara.
Imagine what we could do together though. Your brilliant mind for numbers and strategy, and my on-the-ground experience. We could actually build something that matters. Something real.
That's a powerful thought. It's what I feel is missing. Purpose.
You have it. You just need the right place to apply it. Talking to you makes me feel like big things are possible.
Sam, I'm at my wits end. I'm so angry and heartbroken.
Clara, what is it? What's happened? Are you safe?

I'm safe, but the village isn't. Our big shipment of water filters and medical supplies has arrived in the country, but it's stuck at the port. Some corrupt official is holding it hostage over a 'customs fee' that doesn't exist. It's a bribe.
What? That's awful. Can't the NGO headquarters step in and sort it out?

I've been on the phone all day. It's all 'international protocols' and 'we have to investigate'. It could take weeks. We don't have weeks. The river is contaminated from recent rains and kids are already getting sick. They need these supplies now.
That's an unacceptable nightmare. It puts you in an impossible position.

It's not about me. I just had to watch a mother give her little boy cloudy, boiled water because our filters are sitting in a crate hundreds of miles away. Sorry. It's been a hard day. You're the only person I can even talk to about this.

The official gave my local contact a number. A specific amount to 'expedite the paperwork'. I've tried everything, every official channel. Nothing is moving. I feel like I'm failing this whole community.
This is insane. You're not failing them, the system is. How much is this 'fee'?
It's a lot for here. I don't have it personally. Everything I have goes back into this project. Please don't worry about it, Sam. This isn't your burden.
When kids are getting sick because of a bribe, it becomes everyone's burden. I can't just sit here in my comfortable office and do nothing. I want to help. Let me help.
I couldn't ask you to get involved in this. It's messy and it's not right. What if something goes wrong?

The only thing that can go wrong is if we do nothing. This is what you said I had a mind for - strategy. The strategy right now is to solve the problem. I can wire the money. Tell me what's needed to get it done.
Hey Tom. I saw your profile and your design work is seriously impressive. The clean lines and intentionality... it's what I aim for with my plating. You have a great eye.
Hey, thanks man. Appreciate that. Plating? Are you a chef?
I am. I'm currently doing an intensive program in Lyon, France. Learning from some of the old masters. It's a dream, but a demanding one.
Wow, Lyon. That's incredible. I'm a graphic designer, so I can appreciate the demanding creative process. Very cool.
A man of taste! I knew it. Hey, this app is pretty clunky for sharing photos. I'd love to show you some of the food I'm working on. Are you on Telegram?
Yeah, absolutely. My username is the same. I'd love to see it. Beats the logos I've been staring at all day.
Just got out of the kitchen. 16 hours. I'm exhausted but buzzing. Looking at your portfolio again... it's so damn good. Do you enjoy your agency work?

Thanks, Alex. It pays the bills, you know? But honestly, I'm kind of over designing for big corporations. My dream is to freelance for brands I actually care about, like small restaurants or wineries.
I felt that in my soul. My ultimate goal is to open my own small, farm-to-table restaurant. Nothing stuffy. Just honest, beautiful food. A place with a real identity.
That sounds amazing. That's exactly the kind of client I'd love to work with.
I can already see the branding you'd create for it. The logo, the feel of the menus... you get how to tell a story with design. It would be perfect. *Our* place would be perfect.
Careful, a guy could get carried away with talk like that haha. But it's a hell of a dream.
It's what keeps me going on these long nights. It feels good to share it with someone who gets it.
Tom. You are the first person I'm telling this. The most incredible thing has happened. I'm floating.
Alex? What is it? That sounds amazing!

The chef I'm staging for... he's retiring. He's offered me the chance to take over his restaurant. The lease, the name, everything. It's a legendary spot in Lyon. This is my entire life's dream handed to me on a plate.
NO WAY. That's incredible news! Man, I'm so happy for you! This is it!

It is. Or it was. I got a call from my dad an hour ago. An old business debt of my uncle's, that my dad co-signed for years ago, has been called in. The collectors are threatening to put a lien on my parents' house if it's not paid.
What? That's awful. From elation to that... I'm so sorry, Alex. That's a gut punch.
I have the money for the restaurant deposit. But it's almost the exact amount needed for this debt. I have to choose between saving my family's home and my entire future. I don't know what to do.
I did the only thing I could do. I sent my savings to my dad. I can't let him lose his home. I'll have to tell Chef Antoine tomorrow that I can't take the restaurant. It's gone. I feel so empty.
Alex, you did the right thing for your family. But this isn't fair. The dream, *our* dream restaurant... we can't let it die like this. What was the deposit amount?
It doesn't matter anymore. Please, Tom, don't. This is my family's problem. I can't drag you into it.
It's not about being dragged in. It's about not letting a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity vanish because of some scumbag collector. I have savings. I can be your first investor. Let me do this.
I... I don't know what to say. Are you serious? After everything?
I've never been more serious. You're going to be a brilliant chef with your own place. And you're going to need a great designer. Let's make it happen. Tell me how much, and where to send it.
Hello Daniel. Your picture at the marina caught my eye. It's not often you see someone who looks genuinely at home by the sea.
Hi there. Thanks, that's my happy place for sure. It's the one place I can unwind from my job. Your photos are breathtaking. Are you a diver?
Something like that! I'm a marine biologist doing coral reef restoration work in Indonesia. So I spend more time under the water than on land these days.
Wow, seriously? That's incredible. I'm a lawyer, so my work is about as far from that as you can get. I'm fascinated.
A lawyer! So you have a sharp, logical mind. We need more of those in the conservation world, believe me. Most of us are just passionate science nerds.
Haha, I don't know about sharp, but it's a lot of reading contracts. I'd love to hear more about what your work actually involves. It sounds so important.

I'd love to tell you. It's hard to do it justice in a little chat box though, and this app is terrible for sending photos or videos of the reefs. Are you on Telegram? It's much better for sharing media.
Yes, absolutely. I'd love to see it. My username is the same as here. Don't want to hold you up if you're busy saving the world.
Haha, hardly. Just trying to do my small part. I'll message you there now. 😊
Long day. Just finished a night dive to check on the new coral nurseries. The bioluminescence was magical tonight. How was the world of law today?
That sounds surreal. My day involved a 200-page contract review, so you definitely win. I was thinking about our conversation... do you ever feel overwhelmed by the scale of what you're trying to do?

Every single day. But then I see a turtle swim past, or a new polyp growing, and I remember why I do it. It's the little victories. Do you ever feel like you're on the wrong path, even if it's a 'successful' one?

All the time. My secret dream is to quit corporate law and do environmental law. Pro-bono work for organizations like yours. But I have student loans, a mortgage... it feels impossible to make the leap.
I was thinking about you today, Daniel. What you said about environmental law... It's not an impossible dream. It's who you are.
It's nice of you to say that. It feels good to even say it out loud to someone who gets it.

My ultimate goal here is to establish a permanent, legally protected marine area, run by the local community. The biggest hurdles aren't scientific, they're political and legal. I often feel like I'm drowning in paperwork I don't understand.
That's where people like me are supposed to come in. I can only imagine the bureaucracy.

Exactly. Having someone with a brilliant legal mind to navigate that... to help write the very laws that would protect this place forever... that's the real missing piece. You could literally save this reef.
When you put it like that... it makes my contract reviews seem pretty meaningless.
No, your skills are so meaningful! They just need to be applied to something that sets your soul on fire. Like this. Like our sanctuary.
Ugh. We've had some bad news today. Feeling pretty low.
Maya, what's wrong? Is everything okay over there?
Just some issues with our funding. The local government is changing hands and everything is... complicated. I don't want to bore you with it.

Daniel, it's worse than I thought. A storm blew through last night. It was much stronger than predicted. Our main research boat was damaged and some of our most critical underwater sensors were destroyed.
Oh my god, Maya. Are you and the team alright?

We are safe, thank you. But the project is in jeopardy. The funding for repairs that was promised is now indefinitely frozen because of the government change. We're flying blind. We can't assess the damage to the reef without the boat and sensors.
This is a nightmare. There must be some kind of emergency fund for this?

There is, but the paperwork could take months. The first 48 hours after a storm are critical for intervention if there's a bleaching event. It's like being a doctor for a patient you're not allowed to examine. I feel so helpless.

Update: It's not good. I've spent three days trying every official channel. Nothing. The boat engine needs a specific part we have to import, and the acoustic sensors need to be replaced entirely. Our local boat captain, Budi, depends on that boat for his family's income. Now he has nothing.
This is infuriating. So you have a solution, just no way to pay for it?
Exactly. I'm even considering selling my professional underwater camera setup, but it would take too long and I'd only get a fraction of what it's worth here. It's a desperate thought, I know.

Maya, I've been thinking about this all night. Don't sell your camera. That's your primary tool. This is a logistics problem, and we can solve it. What is the total cost for the engine part and the sensors?
Daniel, no. I can't let you. This is my project's burden. It is not your responsibility to fix my problems. You've already helped so much by listening.
This isn't about fixing your problems, it's about solving a critical issue that I care about. You made me care about it. It's our sanctuary, remember? I'm in a position where I can help. Let me.
I... I'm speechless. Are you absolutely sure? I would pay you back the second the grant money is released.
Consider me the legal counsel for the project making a strategic investment. We'll sort out the details later. The reef can't wait. Just tell me what you need and the best way to get it to you.
Hello Michael. I was scrolling and the photo of your city skyline at night stopped me. It looks so warm and full of life. A beautiful contrast to the beautiful, empty chaos I'm surrounded by.
Hi there. Thanks, that's the view from my apartment. 'Beautiful, empty chaos' sounds very poetic and mysterious. Where are you?
Currently in a small outpost in the Canadian Arctic. I'm a documentary filmmaker, and my current project is on the impact of climate change on the local Inuit communities.
Wow. Okay, that was not what I was expecting. I'm a software engineer, so my life is basically the exact opposite of that. That's an incredibly important story to tell.
It feels important, yes. But very challenging. The logistics are a nightmare. It's nice to talk to someone from the 'real world' for a minute. You seem very thoughtful.
I'm fascinated. I can't even imagine what your day-to-day is like. Must be an adventure.

It is! I'd love to show you some pictures of the Northern Lights if you'd like. This app is awful for sending files though and my satellite data is precious. Do you use Signal? It's much more stable on a weak connection.
I do, yes. I'd be blown away to see that. I'll message you my number. Please don't feel obligated, I know you must be incredibly busy.
It's no obligation at all. It's a pleasure. Will message you now. 😊
Just got back to base camp. It's -30C outside but the stars are like diamonds. Made me think of your city lights. How was your day in the world of code?
-30... I can't even comprehend that. My day was a marathon of meetings about a new feature rollout. I swear, talking to you is the most exciting part of my day.
Honestly, same here. It's a nice escape. Do you ever feel like you want to use your tech skills for something... different? Something outside the corporate box?

Are you a mind reader? Yes. All the time. I have this lingering idea to build an open-source platform for non-profits, to help them manage logistics and data. But it's just an idea. I never seem to have the time.
Michael, I haven't been able to stop thinking about your idea for that non-profit platform. That's not 'just an idea'. That's brilliant. It's revolutionary.
You really think so? I've never told anyone about it who didn't just glaze over.

Think so? I know so! The biggest challenge for independent creators like me is the logistics. Scheduling, data management, release forms... it's a nightmare that takes away from the actual storytelling. A platform like that would change everything.
That's exactly what I was thinking. To handle the backend stuff so people like you can focus on the important work.

My dream is to start my own small production company for these kinds of stories. With your platform, that dream becomes a hundred times more possible. Imagine us partnering on it. You build the tool, and I could be your first featured project. We could empower so many creators.
That's a very compelling vision, Eva. A very... exciting one.
